runMeta.note: Slot buttons on the public booking page display local browser time; storage/API use UTC.

tests.title: 01 · Landing page
tests.name: Landing page
tests.desc: Verifies the public home page renders correctly and offers the two entry CTAs ("Get started" → /signup, "Log in" → /login).

steps.caption: Page / loads with title "Bookly - Appointment Booking"; hero headline and copy visible.
"Get started" and "Log in" buttons present and point to /signup and /login (DOM-verified).

tests.title: 02 · Signup new user
tests.name: Signup new user
tests.desc: Creates a brand-new owner account via /signup and verifies automatic sign-in and the empty-state onboarding.

steps.caption: Signup form shows name / email / password fields on the split auth layout.
Form filled with a unique per-run test account (name, email, password).
Submit redirects to /dashboard showing the "Welcome aboard" onboarding (no business yet).

tests.title: 03 · Create business
tests.name: Create business
tests.desc: Creates the user's first business, which generates its shareable booking URL.

steps.caption: Onboarding form: business name "E2E Studio", unique slug, description, 30-min slot duration.
Business created & selected; booking link /book/<slug> generated; tab bar visible.

tests.title: 04 · Set working hours
tests.name: Set working hours
tests.desc: Defines weekly availability — the time slots customers are allowed to book.

steps.caption: Hours tab shows Sun–Sat rows with on/off switches and time inputs (all off initially).
Toggled Mon, Tue, Wed on with defaults 09:00–17:00; other days stay closed.
Save → state re-verified in DOM: 3 enabled days, each 09:00–17:00.

tests.title: 05 · Add services
tests.name: Add services
tests.desc: Defines what the business offers (name, duration, price).

steps.caption: Services tab shows the "No services yet" empty state before anything is added.
"Piano Lesson" (45 min, $50) added and visible in the list.
"Guitar Lesson" (30 min, $40) added — both services listed with price & duration.

tests.title: 06 · Public booking page
tests.name: Public booking page
tests.desc: What a customer sees on the shareable URL /book/<slug>. The suite picks the first date (within 14 days) that actually has open slots.

steps.caption: Hero shows business name + description; both services in the dropdown with duration & price.
Chosen date shows multiple open slots rendered as selectable time buttons.

tests.title: 07 · Book appointment
tests.name: Book appointment
tests.desc: The full customer booking action, verified end-to-end including the "You're booked!" confirmation.

steps.caption: Service "Piano Lesson" chosen; first available slot highlighted.
Customer details filled: name, email, phone.
Submission succeeds → "You're booked!" confirmation screen.

tests.title: 08 · Dashboard bookings
tests.name: Dashboard bookings
tests.desc: The owner sees booked appointments, and a booked slot cannot be booked again.

steps.caption: Bookings tab lists the appointment: customer, email, phone, service, business, time, status confirmed.
Re-opening the booking page for that date: the booked slot is gone (API-verified) — no double booking.

tests.title: 09 · Theme switcher
tests.name: Theme switcher
tests.desc: The floating dark/light toggle applies the theme instantly and persists the choice.

steps.caption: Initial theme state captured (dark or light, depending on persisted/OS preference).
After clicking the toggle the page theme flipped and the choice was saved to localStorage (DOM-verified).

tests.title: 10 · Logout and login
tests.name: Logout and login
tests.desc: Session termination, route protection via middleware, and re-authentication.

steps.caption: "Log out" clears the session cookie and leaves the app.
Visiting /dashboard while logged out is blocked — redirected to /login.
Logging in with the same credentials returns to /dashboard with the business selected.
